themes.rationale: The review call asked for one integrated operating-model story rather than separate platform and data narratives, so the solution section now presents intake, build, monitor, and audit as a single arc.

operations.text: AIS delivers the solution as one integrated AI/ML operating model: intake the mission need, build governed data and model assets, monitor performance and risk, and audit decisions against agency policy.
operations.rationale: Opens the section with the integrated operating model so the reader meets the arc before the component detail.

operations.text: DataLance supports the AI/ML platform as the data-product and decision-framework layer, giving teams a repeatable way to qualify sources, trace lineage, and move from ingestion to governed intelligence.
operations.rationale: Reframes DataLance as a supporting layer of the platform rather than a parallel offering.
